audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 undersells Vladimir's 57.3% WR over 2165 games slightly, but the shape is right: her Volley poke and Rebuttal reflect win the opening levels, Vladimir's sustain takes over from 4-5 and never gives it back. audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen misgendered fields (Mel is she/her), two copy-paste-bleed bullets, and a cooldowns field with no digit.

Whether Rebuttal reflects Vladimir's E specifically is asserted by existing text and left as-is; not re-verified from the kit.
